description: many_rooms experiment: 20 unbiased rooms (generated the same way as old_cycles), 200s trajectories. Pooled warmup across all rooms (60s TBPTT steps, per-cell Gaussian-smoothed signal, sigma=15). Main training visits all 20 rooms in a shuffled order each cycle (as in old_cycles); for each visit, trains on 4 trajectories one at a time in 20s TBPTT segments (no batching), capturing gradient/optimizer signals after every segment but activation rate maps only once at the end of each trajectory. Repeated for 10 cycles, reshuffling room order each cycle.
